title: Sorting out his relatives and children
summary: Willard clarifies that Osa was his sister's husband and Charles Bryant his brother; Turner had a boy in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: All right, to get things straightened out about from the beginning when you were talkin' about your uncle and your brother-in-law, now, your sister's husband's name is what? You said that, what? First, you called Charles Bryant your uncle but then you said that it...
Osa is my...My sister's husband name is Osa.
Your sister's husband was Osa, and Charles was Osa's brother.
Okay. Got that. I got that straightened out now. And then, Osa and your sister had two sons. Is that right?
Okay. Did you ever have any children?
I...had a little boy in New Orleans...but that was way back. I'm back in California now.
So I lived...after my wife got tired...she was crazy about Chicago but she didn't like out here. So she went back to Chicago. I went wit' her. And...Who is it? [Someone at front door.]
